text.tspan: BREAKING NEWS
@unhappychoice ships gitlogue v0.12.0 with live commit watch mode. Git historians shaken.
JUST IN
@unhappychoice approves 49 PRs in 7 days. Dependabot reportedly sends thank-you card.
MONOID RISING
@unhappychoice launches Monoid Studio website. Domain secured. Logo deployed. World notified.
SATURDAY SURGE
@unhappychoice detonates 298 commits on a Saturday. Weekend plans: cancelled.
POLYGLOT PANIC
@unhappychoice updates Ruby, JS, Rust, Java, and Kotlin deps in a single week. Doctors baffled.
SECURITY THREAT
@unhappychoice merges 2 external security PRs into mdts before anyone notices.
META MOMENT
@unhappychoice updates the weekly reporter's own deps. The snake eats its tail.
GRADLE STORM
@unhappychoice upgrades Gradle to 9.8.0 across 4 repos simultaneously. Seismologists alarmed.
